title: Range compression
description: Short-window average true range divided by long-window average true range is at or below compression_ratio_max, and that condition has held for at least min_bars_compressed consecutive bars.
thesis: Contraction of realised range against its own longer-window baseline is the measurable form of balance. It is the inverse condition to volatility expansion and is stated separately so a chain can require one, the other, or their ordered succession.

required_hermes_fields.purpose: Average true range over short_atr_period bars.
Average true range over long_atr_period bars, forming the baseline.

parameters.name: short_atr_period
parameters.description: Lookback of the short-window average true range, in bars of the evaluated timeframe.

parameters.name: long_atr_period
parameters.description: Lookback of the baseline average true range, in bars of the evaluated timeframe. Must exceed short_atr_period.

parameters.name: compression_ratio_max
parameters.description: Maximum value of atr.short divided by atr.long for the bar to count as compressed. A value of 1.0 admits any bar at or below its own baseline.

parameters.name: min_bars_compressed
parameters.description: Number of consecutive bars, ending at the evaluated bar, on which the ratio condition must hold.

direction_semantics.direction_rule: Compression carries no directional content: it states that the market is moving less per bar, not which way it will resolve. The strategy always emits NEUTRAL.

fields.name: matched
fields.description: True when the ratio condition has held for min_bars_compressed consecutive bars.

fields.name: compression_ratio
fields.description: atr.short divided by atr.long on the evaluated bar.

fields.name: bars_compressed
fields.description: Consecutive bars ending at the evaluated bar on which the ratio condition held.

fields.name: reason
fields.description: The observed ratio, its threshold, the consecutive-bar count and whether each held.

deterministic_test_cases.description: Ratio of 0.5 holds on three consecutive bars, at or below the 0.6 threshold for the required three bars.
Ratio of 0.8 on every bar is above the 0.6 threshold, so no bar counts as compressed.
The ratio clears the threshold on the final two bars only, one short of the required three.

provenance.source_reference: PID.md line 55 — compression, named as a canonical atomic strategy for HSA v1.
provenance.notes: Architect-set defaults. Deliberately expressed on the same two HERMES facts as volatility_expansion with the comparator reversed, so a SEQUENCE chain can require compression followed by expansion without either strategy knowing the other exists.
